rationale.campaign_length: H67可用44项，其中15项同时对H66开放，不能重复相加。
rationale.colonization: 跨海迁移与旱岸聚落建立是关键。
rationale.complexity: 远征撤退、宗教事件、技术研究与后期战争叠加。
rationale.dark_story: 奴役、战争、焚烧和救世主争议为阴暗主题。
rationale.difficulty: 多区域行动要求高；未实机量化。
rationale.diplomacy: 与当地势力、遗民及宗教派系交涉。
rationale.early_pressure: H66前置及旱岸建立需处理跨海局势。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 太阳魔法、先驱技术和飞行器贯穿后期。
rationale.narrative_density: 远征、建国、再返回祖地构成强连续故事。
rationale.tall_play: 旱岸城市建设重要，但支撑远征。
rationale.trade_economy: 聚落生产和资源调度有作用，但贸易不是核心。
rationale.warfare: 泰琴德、埃菲莱和南艾兰提尔战役是主线。

identity.appearance: 1444不存在；贾赫的典范H66远征后可形成

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
雷赞坎德的前身是「贾赫之典范」修会，如今它是一个由诸多神圣修会统治的国家，携手并肩对抗黑暗。雷赞坎德的统治者——耀光先驱，由黎明议会选举产生，该议会由每个修会的领袖组成，不分种族。

雷赞坎德国内有诸多分管文职和军事的修会，少数继承自昔日的布勒瓦尔，但绝大多数是为了满足新国家的需要而建立，填补了世俗机构在其他国家所扮演的同样角色。

此外，雷赞坎德国内最主要的民间团体是负责司法系统的法官修会，以及代表众多工会利益的苏雷尔之仆。最有影响力的军事组织则是复仇者修会，他们的任务是与伊菲莱之间的战争，以及由工程师、奇械术士、法师和冒险者组成的阳舞者修会，他们负责管理移民船迪兰赫里亚。
description.text_en:
Founded by members of the Order of Exemplars, Rezankand is a country dominated by its various Holy Orders, who work together in the fight against Darkness. Rezankand’s Ruler is the Herald of Light, elected by the Conclave of Dawn, an assembly composed of the most senior members from each order, regardless of race.

Rezankand has many civilian and military Holy Orders, some inherited from Bulwar, but the vast majority were established to fulfill the needs of the new country, filling the same role that secular institutions have in other countries.

The main civilian orders are the Order of Judges in charge of the judicial system, and the Servants of Surael which represent the interests of the many artisan guilds. The most influential military orders are the Order of Avengers, tasked with bringing war to the Effelai, and the Order of Sundancers, composed of engineers, artificiers, mages and soldiers who are in charge of the Migrant Ship Diranhriá.

description.text:
雷赞坎德致力于净化南埃兰提尔的黑暗，以保护苏雷尔神的庭院，他们决心在埃兰提尔得胜，而且他们并不孤单。与区分移民精灵和遗迹精灵的其他国家不同，雷赞坎德将他们认为是同一民族：追随神圣太阳的黎明精灵。

大多数精灵在自己漫长的一生中都会努力尝试加入一个修会，而最受欢迎的自然是贾赫典范。此外，即使一位黎明精灵不打算立下誓言投身战场，他们也会毕生致力于磨练和完善自己的武艺。这也有助于履行所有精灵的责任：随时准备反击邪恶黑暗袭来的魔爪。
description.text_en:
Believing that purifying the Darkness of South Aelantir can protect the Garden of Surael, the Rezankandi are determined to triumph in Aelantir, and they are not alone in this endeavor. Contrary to other countries who make distinctions between Migrant Elves and Ruinborn Elves, in Rezankand they are all considered a member of the same race, and those who follow the Sun Cult are known as Dawn Elf.

Most Elves make an effort to join one of the Holy Orders during the course of their long lives, of which the Exemplars is most prominent. They then go on to train and perfect their martial skills, even if they do not intend to take any of the vows. This also serves to fulfill the duty that all Elves feel, that one should always be prepared to fight back against the coming Darkness.

description.text: 当布勒瓦尔诸神殿纷纷皈依贾德教，并加冕贾德帝国的神圣先驱为信仰领袖时，雷赞坎德保持了神殿的自治传统。16世纪中期，贾赫丁大会颁布了多项对新日崇拜的内部改革，其中最重要的是宣布贾赫之使命与苏雷尔之神性已经传承给了典范修会和雷赞坎德国内其余修会。虽然理解新日崇拜创始者的逻辑，但大会认为把天选者之责交给所有的太阳精灵是不明智的，从现在开始，只有那些想要通过成为典范来保护和引导信徒的人，才应该承担天选者之责。
description.text_en: While Bulwari temples converted to the Jadd and proclaimed the Divine-herald as head of the faith, Rezankand maintained the traditional autocephaly of the temples. In the mid-1500s, the Council of Jaherdin enacted multiple reforms within the Cult, the most important being that Jaher’s mission, and thus divinity, had been passed down to the Exemplars and the other Holy Orders of Rezankand. While understanding the logic of the founders of the New Sun Cult, the council decided that tasking the entire Sun Elven race with the duties of being a Chosen was unwise, and that from this moment, only those who want to protect and guide the Faithful by being paragons through example should bear the burden of Chosenhood.

description.text:
雷赞坎德精灵从未原谅加拉文德精灵在乌尔万德的背叛。两个族群曾结盟对抗拉兰卡尔，加拉文德精灵还承诺将放弃奴隶制，让出南方的土地供贾赫典范定居。然而，这是一个卑鄙的骗局，在联盟攻入拉兰卡尔首都并扶植塔谢拉达尔为傀儡统治者后，加拉文德精灵背弃盟友转而和拉兰卡尔结盟，迫使贾赫典范撤退回加特尔贝赖。

从那时起，雷赞坎德精灵和泰琴德精灵之间的仇恨就开始肆虐，雷赞坎德精灵多次从他们在加特尔贝赖的基地入侵该地区。雷赞坎德精灵认为泰琴德的统治者受到了黑暗的侵蚀，因此必须铲除他们才能将人民从压迫中解放出来。
description.text_en:
The Rezankandi never forgave the Kalavendhi for the Betrayal of Urvand. Both groups had been allied against the Larankara, with the promise that the Kalavendhi would abandon slavery and give up lands in the south for the Exemplars to settle. This however was a vile deception, and after the alliance stormed the Larankara capital and installed Tasheladar as a puppet ruler, the Kalavendhi and the Larankara turned against the Exemplars, forcing them to retreat back to Katelperai.

Since then, animosity has run rampant between Rezankand and the Taychendi, with Rezankand invading the region several times from their base in Katelperai. The Rezankandi believe that the rulers of Taychend are corrupted by the Darkness, and thus need to be eradicated in order to liberate their people from oppression.

description.text:
瓦拉姆哈尔的卡罗迪尔是贾达尔军团征服全苏兰平原后唯一幸存下来的太阳精灵统治者，在被赦免离开阿卡勒舍斯的监狱后，他前往了埃兰提尔，陪同典范修会去往加特尔贝赖和大纳加尔，研究那儿的泰琴德之民和先驱精灵遗迹。

在接下来的几十年里，他专注于对魔法和先驱知识的研究，试图破译泰琴德和迪兰赫里亚的秘密。为了获得帮助，他建立了「贾赫丁知识之家」，也被称为「白凤凰学院」，一座学习和研究的中心，卡罗迪尔和他的学生们在此设法解析雷赞坎德于南埃兰提尔发掘的遗物，利用这些知识来修复迪兰赫里亚的各种系统，甚至重新激活了部分先驱精灵遗物。
description.text_en:
Karodir of Varamhar was the only Sun Elf king that survived the Jaddari conquest of the Suran Plain, fleeing with the Exemplars to Aelantir after being freed from Akalšes. He accompanied the Exemplar expedition to Katelperai and Nanru Nakar, where he learned from the Taychendi and from the Precursor ruins.

In the following decades, he focused on the study of magic and precursor knowledge, trying to decipher the relics and artifacts found in Taychend and the Diranhriá. To gain help in this endeavor, he established the House of Knowledge of Jaherdin, also known as the White Phoenix Academy, a center of learning and development, from where Karodir and his students managed to pioneer artificery in Rezankand and South Aelantir, using their knowledge to repair the systems of the Diranhriá, and even to recreate some of the Precursor Artifacts found in Taychend.

description.text:
迪兰赫里亚号是先驱精灵帝国时期一艘强大的无畏舰，根据为数不多的现存记录，它曾参加过对矮人的战争，一发炮弹就摧毁了半数旧港口城舰队。当太阳精灵在灰烬之日逃离南埃兰提尔时，他们带走了迪兰赫里亚号，将这艘无畏舰变成了一艘移民船，之后则成为了贾赫的先驱旗舰。

凤凰帝国成立后，迪兰赫里亚再次被改装翻新成战列舰，并成为落日舰队的旗舰，直到「赤红」武尔辛用这艘战舰冲撞海怪瓦纳穆尔，导致它损坏。这艘战舰一直没有完全修复，在被转移到埃利兹纳后，就一直停放在那里，直到贾赫的典范在前往南埃兰提尔的航程中使用了这艘战舰。

卡罗迪尔设法修复了战舰上一些复杂的魔法系统，将船上武器装备恢复到接近鼎盛时期一半的威力，而这足以让迪兰赫里亚在入侵马拉泰尔时大显神威，摧毁安本纳尔舰队。
description.text_en:
The Diranhriá was Jaher’s precursor ship, a mighty dreadnought of the Precursor Empire, that, according to the few surviving records, fought in the war against the Dwarves, destroying half of old Ovdal Tûngr’s fleet with a single barrage. When the Sun Elves fled from South Aelantir during the Day of Ashen Skies, they took the Sundancer with them, turning the dreadnought into a Migrant Ship.

After the founding of the Phoenix Empire, the Diranhriá was retrofitted again into a battleship and became the flagship of the Sunset fleet, until the ship was damaged when Vulzin the Red charged with the ship against the sea monster Wanamur. The ship was never fully repaired, and once it was moved to Elizna, remained dry-docked there until the Exemplars made use of the vessel for their voyage to South Aelantir.

Karodir managed to repair some of the ship’s intricate magic systems, restoring the Sundancer’s armament to half power, and that power was more than enough for the Dirhariá to decimate the Anbennarian fleet during the invasion of Malatel.

description.text:
贾赫的典范和布勒瓦尔人在干旱海岸定居后，迅速开始改造这片土地。他们修建了农用运河、道路，并在伊菲莱丛林边界设防，因为桀骜不驯的丛林被认为沾染了黑暗气息，这被新日崇拜者视为是在重建文明和秩序。这些新城市装饰着华丽的花园，黎明议会的露台上种满了来自埃兰提尔和布勒瓦尔的植物。

他们建立的花园之国未设围墙，因为没有人预料到伊菲莱会扩大其影响力，然而在伊菲莱绽放时期，丛林的怒火彻底爆发。起初只是密林深处传来的抗拒雷赞坎德人来到埃兰提尔的黑暗的低语，而当丛林控制了美丽的雷赞坎德花园，人们深受其害，不得不烧毁花园，以阻止伤害的进一步蔓延。这场悲剧让雷赞坎德人相信，如果他们想继续留在埃兰提尔，就必须将伊菲莱夷为平地，从埃兰提尔净化这片黑暗。
description.text_en:
When the Exemplars and the Bulwari settled the Dry Coast, they quickly started to transform the land. By constructing agricultural canals, roads, and securing their border with the Effelai, as the untamed jungle is considered tainted by Darkness, this was seen as restoring civilization and order by the Sun Cult. These new cities were decorated with magnificent gardens, and the Conclave of Dawn terraces filled with flora from Aelantir and Bulwar.

They built an unwalled garden of a country, as no one expected the Effelai to expand its influence, however during the Blooming, the jungle’s wrath was unleashed. It started with whispers and rumors about how the Darkness deep within the dense vines and foliage was against our presence in Aelantir, and when the Jungle took control of the wonderful Rezankandi gardens, the people suffered as they had to burn them in order to stop further spreading of the infestation. A tragedy that convinced the Rezankandi that if they wanted to stay in Aelantir, the Effelai had to be burned to the ground, and its Darkness purified from Aelantir.

description.text: 与我们西部的月精灵表亲不同，我们为自己的精灵之血感到骄傲和并注重保护，并且不会因混血而削弱它，而我们的精灵血统仍然是纯正的。
description.text_en: Unlike our Moon Elf cousins to the west we are proud and protective of our elvish blood and don't weaken it with miscegenation, and such remain pure and true heirs of elvenkind.

description.text: 布勒瓦尔一直以空中平台，飞行的战车而著名，由一名法师驾驶，另外两名法师则从高空带来死亡。他们不仅在我们部队到达之前轰炸紧凑型编队非常方便，而且在侦察中也很方便。
description.text_en: Bulwar has always been famous for its sky platforms, flying chariots, piloted by a mage with two others flinging death from above. They are not only very handy in bombarding compact formations before they reach our troops but also in scouting.

description.text: 我们需要防止任何可能的叛逆者掌握魔法艺术。我们必须将任何潜在的「不可靠」因素赶出魔法学校。
description.text_en: We need to prevent any possible rebels to master the arts of magic. We must kick any potentially 'unreliable' elements out of magical schools.

description.text: 由于我们的长寿，我们的行政人员有很多时间来学习管理一个国家的来龙去脉。
description.text_en: Due to our long lives our administrators have lots of time to learn the ins and outs of running a country.

description.text: 我们的豪华宫殿享有很高的声誉，以至于我们往往淹没在希望在其中工作的潜在顾问中。腐化似乎有其优势。
description.text_en: Our luxurious palaces have such good reputations that we tend to drown in potential advisors wishing to work in them. It appears decadence has its advantages.

description.text: 我们人民的教育是我们国家的支柱。于我们可以在其一生中积累很多东西，因此我们可以产生最有影响力的诗人，政治家，自然哲学家和学者。
description.text_en: The education of our people is the backbone of our state. As we can accumulate a lot of it in our long lives, we can produce the most influential poets, statesmen, natural philosophers and scholars.

description.text: 我们的王国以争夺王位和阴谋而闻名。如果我们成功地将自己从阴谋中获得的经验转化为外在的东西，我们将拥有一个强大的工具。
description.text_en: Our kingdoms are known its vying dynastic families and intrigue. If we manage to turn the experience in plotting we gained from this outwards we have a great tool in our hands.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿经历前置远征、宗教政治和大规模后期战争的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先完成跨海远征与建国，再经营旱岸、吸纳遗民，最后展开反奴役和对抗丛林的大战。
player_overview.overview: 先经历贾赫的典范H66远征，进入泰琴德，再在旱岸建立雷赞坎德H67。你会迎接祖地遗民、组织圣骑团和自由民，挑战奴隶主与军阀；后期把太阳魔法、先驱遗物和飞行装置用于横跨南艾兰提尔的远征。宏大的英雄史诗始终伴随外来者是否尊重当地人的质疑。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢圣骑士史诗、跨海开拓、魔法奇械混合和长线救赎故事的玩家。
signature_features: H66序章形成H67；44项H67可用任务中15项与H66共享。
泰琴德突袭与撤往旱岸、解放奴隶的战役。
圣骑团、先驱技术、魔法飞行器和埃菲莱丛林。
player_overview.tagline: 跨海回到精灵祖地的太阳圣骑国，解放奴隶，也可能把救赎变成征服。

reasons: 远征—建国—归来构成完整史诗
反奴役与外来救赎的张力
太阳魔法和先驱奇械并用
warnings: 重做前玩家评论不代表当前树
后期跨大陆战争规模很大

positive_indicators: 解放奴隶并接纳迁徙者
将祖地遗民视为同胞而非资源
values.rationale: 释放奴隶、保护遗民和建设多族群旱岸有明确积极证据；但以圣光使命代替当地自主判断、宗教军事扩张和焚烧丛林降低克制与人格承认。战争与神权本身不扣分。
red_flags: 外来救世主叙事可能压低当地自主权
对丛林使用大规模焚烧
